audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 1-3 were 'Skill' though the prose calls levels 2-5 yours; Level 6 was 'Skill' though The Show Stopper is his spike; 2+ items was Urgot though Haymaker's true damage evens it.
audit.why: The mirror audit (sett vs urgot) set Levels 1-3 to Urgot, Level 6 to Sett on The Show Stopper, and 2+ items to a skill fight. Mirroring that keeps both pages telling the same story.
audit.corrected: Urgot Levels 1 through 4-5, Sett at Level 6, Urgot at first item, skill at two items.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as your spike with no mention of The Show Stopper's cooldown or grounding.
audit.why: Riot kit: The Show Stopper is 120/100/80s at 400 range and carries a grounding flag — it shuts off Disdain, your only escape, mid-fight. That inverts who owns Level 6.
audit.corrected: Level 6 is his: The Show Stopper is 120s at rank 1 and grounds you out of the Disdain escape. Bait it before committing.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'True Grit shield' is a fabricated ability name (three places), Facebreaker is described as a flat engage stun, and the late-game build advice rests on percent-health shred from Purge.
audit.why: Sett's shield comes from Haymaker (W); his passive is Pit Grit — no ability is called True Grit. Facebreaker stuns only when enemies are on opposite sides of him; solo in lane it slows. Haymaker's centre is true damage, so armour is the wrong answer, and Riot's Purge text has no percent-max-health component.
audit.corrected: Facebreaker (16s rank 1, 490 range) only stuns with bodies on both sides — solo it is a slow. Haymaker's centre is true damage, so buy health, not armour, and hold R for after his shield is spent.

edits.before: Fear Beyond Death online — at 25% HP Sett is simply dead. Trade him to half, then the chain threat decides everything.
edits.after: Fear Beyond Death online, but so is The Show Stopper — 120s, and it grounds your escape. Bait his ult before you commit.

edits.before: - Sett Facebreaker (Stun): matchup-defining — His engage stun. Dodge it and keep spacing. Track it before every engage. - Sett Facebreaker: Pulls enemies on both sides together and stuns if hit from both sides. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Facebreaker: 16s at rank 1, 490 range. Alone in lane it only slows you — the stun needs a body on each side, so his jungler arriving is the real threat. - The Show Stopper: 120s, and it grounds you.

edits.before: His engage stun. Dodge it and keep spacing. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: It only stuns with enemies on both sides — solo, it is a slow. Fear it when he has help.

edits.before: Late game your R is a pick machine: any frontliner dropped under 25% dies through everything. Anchor fights around the execute threat and W-shred whoever dives your carries. Sett carry threat: 6/10 — end the game before he cashes it.
edits.after: Late game your R is a pick machine: anyone dropped under its threshold dies through everything. Anchor fights around the execute threat and W-shred whoever dives your carries. Sett carry threat: 6/10 — end before he cashes it.

edits.before: Level 6 is yours, R executing past his True Grit shield.
edits.after: Level 6 is his — Show Stopper grounds your Disdain escape.

edits.before: With two items you keep it, percent-health shred melting his health build.
edits.after: With two items it is even, Haymaker true damage cutting past your armour.

edits.before: Your R (Fear Beyond Death) beats his all-in. Even if he E (Facebreaker) pulls and W-Haymakers, Purge him low and R to execute past his True Grit shield.
edits.after: Level 6 is his window: The Show Stopper is 120s and grounds you, so Disdain will not carry you out. Bait it, then Purge him low and execute.

edits.before: You keep the duel. Your percent-health shred (W) melts his health-stacked build and R executes; Sett scales as a teamfight bruiser but cannot win the sidelane 1v1.
edits.after: Haymaker's centre is true damage, so stacked armour does nothing — take health instead. Duel him only with Disdain up; The Show Stopper is 120s and grounds you out of the escape.

edits.before: You keep the duel late: Urgot's percent-health W-shred melts Sett's health-stacked build and R executes past his shield. He scales as a teamfight bruiser, not a 1v1 sidelaner.
edits.after: Late is closer. Haymaker's centre is true damage, so armour is the wrong answer — take health and Sterak's, hold R for the moment his shield is spent, and duel him with Disdain up.

edits.before: Hit R to execute past his True Grit shield

notes: 'True Grit' is not a Sett ability — the shield is on Haymaker (W), passive is Pit Grit. Removed from the three places it appeared. report[11].t and report[5].t still carry the 25% execute number and the '(Stun)' suffix in the focus name; left alone this pass to stay inside the length band. The missingInteractions 'dash-denied' entry names Corrosive Charge as the denied dash — Riot's Q text is a location-targeted charge, no dash; Disdain (E) is what The Show Stopper's grounding actually denies, and that is what was written.
